issues.title: Inconsistent border outline
issues.description: The top border line extends beyond the active toggle group items.
issues.evidence: The top horizontal border spans wider than the toggle group item segment boundaries.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the top border within the toggle group container wrapper.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: ToggleGroupItem used physical-side utilities (first:rounded-l-md, last:rounded-r-md, border-l-0/first:border-l) which invert in RTL — rounding lands on interior edges, the group's start-edge outer border is missing, and a doubled divider appears at the wrong junction; replaced with logical rounded-s/rounded-e/border-s utilities (same idiom as ui/input-otp).
